pages.text: The sun is hot. {{hero}} has a big red hat. {{hero}} and Mom sit on a log in the sun. It is fun!
{{hero}} can see a tan pup. The pup is in the mud. Can {{hero}} get the pup to sit on the rug?
The pup did not sit. The pup got the red hat! The pup ran and ran. {{hero}} ran to the pup, but the pup hid in a box.
{{hero}} sat on the rug. {{hero}} set a bun on the mat. The pup got up and sat. {{hero}} got the hat, and the pup got a pat!
The sun is set. {{hero}} and the pup get in bed. Mom has a hug for {{hero}}. But the pup dug up a tin box. What is in it?
